topics.name: Angels
topics.summary: Throughout Scripture angels are God's messengers and servants who announce his works, guard and minister to his people, worship God, and must never themselves be worshiped.

refs.text: Jacob's dream: angels ascending and descending
He will give his angels charge over thee
Seraphim cry Holy, holy, holy

topics.name: Baptism
topics.summary: Christ commands baptism in the triune name, linking it with repentance, faith and union with his death and resurrection, pictured beforehand in the Old Testament's washings and deliverances; traditions differ on its mode, subjects and effect.

refs.text: Israel passes through the sea (compare 1 Corinthians 10:1–2)

topics.name: Church
topics.summary: The church is the people God has called together in Christ, rooted in his promise to bless all nations through Abraham: his body, household and temple, built on the apostles' witness and gathered for teaching, fellowship and mutual care.

topics.name: Comfort in Suffering
topics.summary: Scripture teaches that God comforts his people in affliction, uses suffering to shape character, shares it in Christ, and promises that present sorrows will give way to glory.

God will wipe away every tear

topics.name: Courage
topics.summary: Courage in Scripture is not self-confidence but trust in God's presence: Be strong and of good courage, for the Lord your God is with you.

refs.text: He will not fail thee, nor forsake thee

topics.name: Covenant
topics.summary: God binds himself to his people by covenant: with Noah, with Abraham, with Israel at Sinai and with David, and finally in the promised new covenant that Jesus inaugurates in his blood.

topics.name: Creation
topics.summary: God created the heavens and the earth by his word, made humanity in his image and declared it very good; the New Testament reveals Christ as the one through whom all things were made and who will make all things new.

refs.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth

topics.name: Cross
topics.summary: Foreshadowed in the ram Abraham offered and the Passover lamb, and foretold by psalmist and prophet, the cross stands at the center of the gospel: there Christ died for sinners, bore sin, reconciled people to God, and triumphed over evil powers.

topics.name: Discipleship and Obedience
topics.summary: Following Jesus means learning from him, putting his words into practice, counting the cost, and showing love for him by keeping his commandments in every part of life.

topics.summary: Eternal life is knowing God through Jesus Christ, given now to all who believe; Scripture offers believers confidence that nothing can separate them from God's love.

topics.summary: Faith is trusting God and his promises, as Abraham did, promises now fulfilled in Christ; it is the means by which people receive salvation, and a living confidence that shows itself in obedient action.

topics.summary: God freely forgives the sins of all who repent and trust in Christ's shed blood, and those who have been forgiven are commanded to forgive others from the heart.
